interconnect_ordering_requirements: A read R1 request must be issued before a read R2 request, where R2 is received after R1, with the same ID and to the same or overlapping locations.
A write W1 request must be issued before a write W2 request, where W2 is received after W1, with the same ID and to the same or overlapping locations.
Same-ID requests must be observed in issue order at every channel.
Write response BRESP is returned in same-AWID issue order.
register_slice_insertion_rule: Register slices may be inserted in any AXI channel and in any ACE snoop channel at the cost of an additional cycle of latency. ACE snoop channels may use the same register-slice insertion rules as the AXI channels.

extraction_strategy.l9_integration_concepts_v0_1_72: R40: overlaid 9 integration concepts for bus_interconnect_protocol class

default_signal_values_when_omitted: See Table A9-1..A9-4 (master write, slave write, master read, slave read). Examples: AWBURST defaults to 0b01 INCR; AWLEN defaults to all zeros (length 1); AWSIZE defaults to log2(DATA_WIDTH/8); WSTRB defaults to all ones; AWPROT defaults to 0b010 (Unprivileged Non-secure Data).

interconnect_id_handling.id_widening: When a master is connected to an interconnect, the interconnect appends additional bits to the master's xID to distinguish requests from different masters at the slave-side port.
interconnect_id_handling.id_collision_avoidance: The slave-side ID_WIDTH must accommodate the maximum of (master-side ID_WIDTH + log2(number_of_masters)).
interconnect_id_handling.id_routing: For read data, interconnect uses the appended bits of RID to determine which master port the data is destined for. Interconnect removes these bits before passing RID back to the originating master.

ace_specific_integration_components.Point_of_Serialization_POS: System-level cache controller or coherency manager; orders all coherent operations to a given address.
ace_specific_integration_components.Point_of_Coherency_PoC: Location of master copy for Non-shareable addresses.
ace_specific_integration_components.Snoop_Filter: Optional — tracks which masters cache which addresses; requires accurate Evict / WriteEvict notifications.
ace_specific_integration_components.ACE_Lite_master_ports: Non-cached ports (DMA / GPU / IO) that issue coherent reads/writes without owning a snoop port.
ace_specific_integration_components.Coherency_Manager: Aggregates snoop responses, manages PassDirty propagation, enforces 5-state invariants.

interconnect_role_in_ace: Collect CR + CD; aggregate snoop results.
Combine snoop data + memory data; build RRESP[3:2] / BRESP[2].
Wait for RACK / WACK before issuing dependent snoops.

ace_property_declarations.Cache_Coherent: True if the master maintains a snoop-able cache that can respond to AC snoops on CR/CD.
ace_property_declarations.Supports_DVM: True if the master can process DVM messages (TLB invalidate / BP invalidate / IC invalidate / VA sync).
ace_property_declarations.WriteEvict_supported: True if the master emits WriteEvict transactions (requires AWUNIQUE).
ace_property_declarations.Snoop_Filter_aware: Interconnect property — interconnect tracks shareable allocations and uses Evict to maintain.
ace_property_declarations.ReadNotSharedDirty_support: Master may decline SharedDirty by choosing ReadNotSharedDirty.

fields.register_slice_insertion_rule: Register slices may be inserted in any AXI channel and in any ACE snoop channel at the cost of an additional cycle of latency. ACE snoop channels may use the same register-slice insertion rules as the AXI channels.
fields.compatibility_with_AXI4_only_masters: AXI4 master on ACE interconnect: treated as ACE-Lite at AxDOMAIN=Non-shareable (no snooping). ACE master on AXI4 interconnect: snoop port tied off; Non-shareable only.

interconnect_id_handling_inherited.id_widening: AXI baseline: interconnect appends bits to ARID/AWID for routing.
interconnect_id_handling_inherited.id_routing: Inherited from AXI baseline; ACE adds RACK/WACK to confirm response delivery so the interconnect can drain outstanding snoops safely.
interconnect_id_handling_inherited.ace_snoop_id: Snoop traffic on AC/CR/CD is not tagged with AXI IDs; targeting is per-master-port.

interconnect_ordering_requirements_ace: All transactions with a given AXI ID must remain in order (inherited from AXI).
Snoop responses on CR for a given master must be in the same order as the AC requests that elicited them.
RACK/WACK must be observed by the interconnect before issuing a dependent snoop or write-back to the same address.
Barrier transactions block reordering within the named domain.
DVMComplete must be returned only after all targeted masters have acknowledged the corresponding DVMMessage.
